sql: with pt as ( select pt.strategy bk, split_part(pt.market_ticker,'-',2) contest, pt.market_ticker tk, pt.pnl::float pnl, pt.created_at cr, pt.closed_at cl, extract(epoch from (pt.closed_at - pt.created_at))/3600.0 hold, case when pt.side='no' then 100-pt.assumed_price else pt.assumed_price end ypx, split_part(pt.market_ticker,'-',1) ser from paper_trades pt where pt.status in ('settled','closed_sl') and split_part(pt.market_ticker,'-',1) in ('KXNFLSPREAD','KXNFLTOTAL') ), nfl as (select * from pt where ser='KXNFLSPREAD'), lost as (select tk, bool_or(pnl<0) l from nfl group by 1), liv as (select f.market_ticker tk, f.quantity q, f.price p from fills f where f.market_ticker like 'KXNFLSPREAD-%') select 'P_contest'::text sec, contest k, count(*)::text a, count(distinct tk)::text b, count(*) filter (where pnl<0)::text c, round(sum(pnl)::numeric,2)::text d, round((100*sum(pnl)/count(*))::numeric,2)::text e, min(cl)::date::text f from nfl group by 2 union all select 'Q_hold', ser||'/'||(case when hold is null then 'zz_null' when hold<1 then 'a_<1h' when hold<2 then 'b_1-2h' when hold<4 then 'c_2-4h' when hold<12 then 'd_4-12h' when hold<48 then 'e_12-48h' else 'f_48h+' end), count(*)::text, count(distinct tk)::text, count(*) filter (where pnl<0)::text, round(sum(pnl)::numeric,2)::text, round((100*sum(pnl)/count(*))::numeric,2)::text, round(avg(ypx)::numeric,1)::text from pt group by 2 union all select 'R_live', 'realized', sum(liv.q)::text, count(*)::text, sum(case when lost.l then liv.q else 0 end)::text, round((sum(case when lost.l then -liv.p*liv.q else (100-liv.p)*liv.q end)/100.0)::numeric,2)::text, round(avg(liv.p)::numeric,1)::text, count(distinct liv.tk)::text from liv left join lost on lost.tk = liv.tk union all select 'S_livecov', case when lost.l is null then 'no_paper_row' when lost.l then 'lost' else 'won' end, count(*)::text, sum(liv.q)::text, '', '', round(avg(liv.p)::numeric,1)::text, '' from liv left join lost on lost.tk = liv.tk group by 2 order by 1,2
purpose: KXNFLSPREAD: per-contest P&L, hold buckets vs NFLTOTAL, live realized
